metadata.question: Was the water extent at the River Nene larger, specifically 5 km radius around (53.083908, -0.819876) on January 4,2024 than on January 5, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at (53.083908, -0.819876) with 5 km radius - Dates: January 4, 2024 vs January 5, 2022 - Collection: Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection (all-weather), or Sentinel-2/Landsat with water indices - Use Sentinel-1 VV polarization for water detection (water appears dark in SAR) 2. Masking strategy: - For water detection, we want to identify water pixels, not mask them - Use SAR backscatter threshold or water indices (NDWI/MNDWI) to detect water - Sentinel-1: VV < -15 dB typically indicates water 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: Water extent could legitimately be 0 (no water detected) - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare water pixel counts between dates to determine if 2024 > 2022 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-0.819876, 53.083908]); const roi = point.buffer(5000); // 5 km radius const date2022 = '2022-01-05'; const date2024 = '2024-01-04'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-1 SAR const s1_2022 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2022, ee.Date(date2022).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .select('VV'); const s1_2024 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2024, ee.Date(date2024).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .select('VV'); const count2022 = s1_2022.size().getInfo(); const count2024 = s1_2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images: ${count2022}`); console.log(`2024 Images: ${count2024}`); // Check if collections are empty - try wider date range if needed if (count2022 === 0 || count2024 === 0) { console.log("Trying wider date range (+/- 3 days)..."); const s1_2022_wide = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2022-01-02', '2022-01-08') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .select('VV'); const s1_2024_wide = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2024-01-01', '2024-01-07') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .select('VV'); const count2022_wide = s1_2022_wide.size().getInfo(); const count2024_wide = s1_2024_wide.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Wide Images: ${count2022_wide}`); console.log(`2024 Wide Images: ${count2024_wide}`); if (count2022_wide === 0 || count2024_wide === 0) { console.log("No data available for comparison."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Use wider range data var img2022 = s1_2022_wide.mosaic(); var img2024 = s1_2024_wide.mosaic(); } else { var img2022 = s1_2022.mosaic(); var img2024 = s1_2024.mosaic(); } // 3. Water Detection - VV < -15 dB indicates water const water2022 = img2022.lt(-15); const water2024 = img2024.lt(-15); // 4. Calculate water extent (pixel count) const waterStats2022 = water2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterStats2024 = water2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels2022 = waterStats2022.get('VV_sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels2022 = waterStats2022.get('VV_count').getInfo(); const waterPixels2024 = waterStats2024.get('VV_sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels2024 = waterStats2024.get('VV_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2022: Water pixels: ${waterPixels2022}, Total pixels: ${totalPixels2022}`); console.log(`2024: Water pixels: ${waterPixels2024}, Total pixels: ${totalPixels2024}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (waterPixels2022 === null || waterPixels2024 === null) { console.log("Calculation failed - null result."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (totalPixels2022 === 0 || totalPixels2024 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in ROI."); console.log("C2"); return; } const waterArea2022 = waterPixels2022 * 1000000; // pixels * scale^2 (m²) const waterArea2024 = waterPixels2024 * 1000000; console.log(`2022 Water extent: ${(waterArea2022 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2024 Water extent: ${(waterArea2024 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km²`); if (waterPixels2024 > waterPixels2022) { console.log("Water extent was larger on January 4, 2024."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Water extent was NOT larger on January 4, 2024."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
